conoha.vps.database.note: Database server plans (DBサーバー) by flavor, hourly billing up to the monthly amount; the flavor's disk size (d10 to d1000) names the plan. Tax-inclusive yen as published. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

conoha.vps.linux.note: Hourly billing (時間課金): the monthly amount, which a month's hours never exceed, for the plans on sale. Tax-inclusive yen as published. The flavor names of the 12 GB to 128 GB plans are from https://doc.conoha.jp/reference/api-vps3/api-utilization-vps3/api-create_vm-v3/. Read on the pricing page; ConoHa publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

conoha.vps.linux_old_memory.note: Hourly billing of the 8 GB to 64 GB plans that the 12 GB to 96 GB plans replaced in March 2025, for servers still on them: the monthly amount. Tax-inclusive yen, from the old memory plans' price sheet the pricing page links (ConoHa VPS Ver 3.0の旧メモリプラン)
